prompts.few_shots_prompt: import json read_skill_md(skill_name='govmatter-source-proof-dataflow', additional_files=[]) opened = json.loads(govmatter_open(scenario_id='nanjing-adult-valid-old-card')) assert opened['status'] == 'opened' task_id = opened['task_id'] assert task_id.startswith('task-') and len(task_id) == 37 task = json.dumps({'task_id': task_id}) retrieved = govmatterflow_retriever(task=task) verified = govmatterflow_verifier(task=task) state = json.loads(govmatter_state(task_id=task_id)) assert state['task_id'] == task_id and state['can_finalize'] result = govmatter_finalize(task_id=task_id) answer = json.loads(result) assert answer['task_id'] == task_id and answer['status'] == 'DRAFT_PROOF_READY' assert answer['human_review'] == 'pending' and answer['knowledge_published'] is False assert answer['formal_business_answer'] is False final_answer(result)
